name: waypoint
description: Shows which phase a change is in, from the issue's checklist and the OpenSpec tasks, for the current repo and every tracked project.

defaultHost.title: Default host
defaultHost.description: Host used by /where add when given a bare group/repo path, e.g. github.com or gitlab.example.com.

paneColumns.title: Pane width
paneColumns.description: Columns the pane asks for when docked beside the transcript. A width you drag the pane to wins.
